xrefdescription.para: Malformed request rejection Transport adapter rejects empty method with ERR_TRANSPORT_MALFORMED_REQUEST
Malformed request rejection Transport adapter rejects empty path with ERR_TRANSPORT_MALFORMED_REQUEST
Bounded payload enforcement Transport adapter rejects oversized payloads with ERR_TRANSPORT_PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE
Content-Type validation Transport adapter enforces Content-Type header for POST requests
Version negotiation Transport adapter supports v1, v2 and rejects unsupported versions
Version negotiation Transport adapter rejects unsupported API versions with ERR_TRANSPORT_UNSUPPORTED_VERSION
Concurrent request handling Multiple threads can safely call handle() concurrently
Bounded resource behavior under load Adapter gracefully handles rapid request/response cycles
Correlation ID propagation Requests with X-Correlation-ID header are echoed in response X-Correlation-ID
Request without correlation ID Requests without X-Correlation-ID result in no X-Correlation-ID in the response (X-Request-ID is always present as a separately generated per-request identifier)
Response header normalization All responses include Content-Type and X-Request-ID headers
GET requests with no body GET requests are processed correctly even if body is provided (ignored)
Empty payload handling POST/PUT requests with empty body are accepted (no Content-Type enforcement for empty body)
